deployments_detail.use: TravelersLLM: proprietary insurance-specific large language model tailored to its property & casualty business, enhancing underwriting analysis, accelerating research and model development, and giving instant access to decades of institutional knowledge. Won the 2026 CIO 100 Award. [In-house (built by Travelers engineers/data scientists; works alongside leading frontier models)]
deployments_detail.value: Trained on millions of company documents; tested against tens of thousands of insurance-related questions; outperformed commercially available AI models

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered aerial/geospatial catastrophe damage assessment: high-resolution aerial imagery (aircraft flown over affected areas, often within 24 hours of an event) combined with geospatial data and AI-trained models to rapidly identify and classify wind, hail or fire damage via the Catastrophe Map Viewer, speeding claim response after hurricanes, tornadoes and wildfires. [none]

IntelliDrive telematics program: smartphone-app usage-based insurance that captures driving behavior (speed, braking, phone use, miles) and uses analytics/AI models to score driving and set personalized auto insurance pricing/discounts. [TrueMotion (telematics app provider)]

AI Claim Assistant: a fully agentic intelligent voice service that guides customers through first notice of loss for auto damage claims via natural conversation (policy info, photo upload, appraisal scheduling, rental arrangement, handoff to live specialists). Launched in 8 states Feb 2026, expanded countrywide within two months. [OpenAI (GPT models + Realtime API)]
deployments_detail.value: 85-90% of customers using the AI Assistant complete their claim filing through AI

deployments_detail.use: TravAI: secure, in-house agentic AI platform providing all employees access to frontier generative-AI models integrated with internal systems, used broadly for productivity and knowledge work across the enterprise. [In-house platform (multiple frontier models)]
